result.title: FlashDiffusion: Fused Tiled Kernel Spectral Decomposition
result.summary: Diffusion maps, and kernel methods more generally, provide an interpretable nonlinear spectral representation basis for geometric learning. In the geometric limit, small bandwidth, these matrices tend to be high rank and thus require materializing dense Gaussian kernels requires $O(N^2)$ memory. We introduce FlashDiffusion, a matrix-free method that evaluates dense Gaussian kernel blocks in fused GPU tiles and couples the eigensolver to an empirical $β$-flow that selects the finite-sample resolution scale. A continuation over sample size and bandwidth warm-starts increasingly expensive spectral solves from coarser resolutions.

AI.brief_summary: FlashDiffusion 提出一种无矩阵（matrix-free）方法，在 GPU 融合分块中计算稠密高斯核，并将特征求解器与经验 β-flow 结合来选择有限样本的分辨率尺度，用多分辨率热启动加速谱求解。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属数值线性代数与扩散映射/谱方法的 GPU 加速，未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，缺少与 LVR 主线的实质联系。
